# Mindmap syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-mindmap/grammar/mindmap.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

Mindmap syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `mindmap` diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF and CR read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read
as `='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with
`style…:…#…;` (or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities read as
opaque text that no rule takes apart; and a line break appended. Keywords are matched without
regard to case.

A node's parent is the nearest node above it with less indent; the first node is the root, and
a later node with no parent is an error. A `:::class` or `::icon(…)` line decorates the last
node written before it. A blank or comment line counts as a statement where one may start, so a
node right after two of them in a row, or one right after `mindmap`, is an error, as in
mermaid@12.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A mindmap is `mindmap`, then its statements, each followed by a line break, a blank line
or the end. Blank and comment lines may come before `mindmap`.

```ebnf
diagram = [ SPACELINE { SPACELINE | NL } ] MINDMAP [ NL ] statement stop { statement stop } ;
```

```ebnf
stop = ( NL | EOF | SPACELINE ) { NL | EOF } ;
```

```ebnf
statement = SPACELIST [ Node | Icon | Class ]
          | SPACELINE
          | Node
          | Icon
          | Class ;
```

A node: an id, a shape with its text, or both (`root`, `id[text]`, `((text))`). Its indent
is the `SPACELIST` before it.

```ebnf
Node @Node = NODE_ID [ shape ]
           | shape ;
```

```ebnf
shape = NODE_DSTART NODE_DESCR NODE_DEND ;
```

`::icon(…)`: the icon of the last node, on a line of its own.

```ebnf
Icon = ICON ;
```

`:::class …`: the classes of the last node, on a line of its own; a later one replaces them.

```ebnf
Class = CLASS ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `class`, `icon`, `node`, `nstr`, `nstr2`.

Every rule ignores case: a rule for `ab` also matches `AB` and `aB`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | SPACELINE | `\s*%%.*` |  | A `%%` comment v12's comment removal left (after text on a line, or a bare `%%`), with the blanks and line breaks before it: a blank line. |
| INITIAL | MINDMAP | `mindmap\b` |  | `mindmap`: starts a mindmap; the nodes follow, one per line. |
| INITIAL | — | `:::` | push(class) | `:::class …`: the classes of the last node, the rest of the line. |
| class | CLASS | `.+` | pop |  |
| class | — | `\n` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `::icon\(` | push(icon) | `::icon(…)`: the icon of the last node, up to `)`. |
| INITIAL | SPACELINE | `[\s]+[\n]` |  | Blanks up to the last line break of their run: a blank line. |
| INITIAL | NL | `[\n]+` |  |  |
| icon | ICON | `[^\)]+` |  |  |
| icon | — | `\)` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `-\)` | push(node) | A shape opener: `[` square, `(` rounded (cloud unless closed by `)`), `((` circle, `)` cloud, `))` bang, `{{` hexagon; `-)` and `(-` give the default shape. |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\(-` | push(node) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\)\)` | push(node) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\)` | push(node) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\(\(` | push(node) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\{\{` | push(node) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\(` | push(node) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\[` | push(node) |  |
| INITIAL | SPACELIST | `[\s]+` |  | The indent before a node: its width sets the nesting. |
| INITIAL | NODE_ID | `[^\(\[\n\)\{\}]+` |  | A node id, which may hold blanks: the text up to a shape opener or the line end. |
| INITIAL | EOF | `$` |  | The end of the text. |
| node | — | `["][`]` | push(nstr2) | Strings in a shape: `"…"` and markdown strings `` "`…`" ``. The text of either may hold a tag with `="x"` attributes (`<span style="color:red">`), which the lexer reads as `='x'` (#837). |
| nstr2 | NODE_DESCR | `(?:<\w+(?:[^>"`]\|="[^">`]*")*>\|[^`"])+` |  |  |
| nstr2 | — | `[`]["]` | pop |  |
| node | — | `["]` | push(nstr) |  |
| nstr | NODE_DESCR | `(?:<\w+(?:[^>"]\|="[^">]*")*>\|[^"])+` |  |  |
| nstr | — | `["]` | pop |  |
| node | NODE_DEND | `[\)]\)` | pop | A shape closer: any of them closes any shape. |
| node | NODE_DEND | `[\)]` | pop |  |
| node | NODE_DEND | `[\]]` | pop |  |
| node | NODE_DEND | `\}\}` | pop |  |
| node | NODE_DEND | `\(-` | pop |  |
| node | NODE_DEND | `-\)` | pop |  |
| node | NODE_DEND | `\(\(` | pop |  |
| node | NODE_DEND | `\(` | pop |  |
| node | NODE_DESCR | `[^\)\]\(\}]+` |  | A node's text: up to a closer, over line breaks; a `}` takes the rest of its line. |
| node | NODE_DESCR | `.+(?!\(\()` |  |  |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{[\s\S]*?\}%%`
